title: Umami Stir Fry Delight
description: A simple and satisfying stir fry recipe combining sweet and savory flavors. This dish can be prepared quickly and is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and cook for another minute, until lightly browned.
Add the brown sugar, umami stir-fry sauce, and stir-fry until well combined.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
